case_number: 2024 INSC 173; CIVIL APPEAL NO. [Arising out of SLP (C) No. 17973 of 2015]

parties.petitioner: District Appropriate Authority Under the PNDT Act and Chief District Health Officer

summary: Interpretation of PC&PNDT Act Sections 20(1), 20(2), and 20(3); suspension without notice under s.20(3) in public interest; distinction between ordinary suspension/cancellation (s.20(1)-(2)) and exceptional public-interest suspension (s.20(3)); High Court's finding that reasons for s.20(3) suspension invalid; Court held s.20(3) is independent, non-obstante clause allows suspension without notice; power is interim, exercisable only when necessary in public interest; impugned High Court judgment set aside.
legal_provisions_cited: Pre-conception and Pre-Natal Diagnostic Techniques (Regulation & Prevention of Misuse) Act, 1994 s.20(1), s.20(2), s.20(3)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; suspension under s.20(3) upheld.
